teaching.title: Apostolic Succession
teaching.body: Apostolic succession means that the authority Christ gave to the apostles has been passed down through a continuous laying-on of hands in episcopal ordination. Each bishop today can trace his ordination lineage back through an unbroken chain to the apostles themselves. This was already documented by Irenaeus of Lyon (~180 AD) as a criterion for authentic Christianity against Gnostic innovation.
